summary: T3 (ics-import-t3) complete: the authenticated, rate-limited POST /api/v1/calendars/:calendar_id/import-ics endpoint is exposed with role-based access, stable error codes, media-type/size validation, Standard rate-limit tier, and content-free logs. All acceptance criteria are met by existing in-tree code plus one new HTTP-level test proving the stable calendar_import_limit_exceeded code end-to-end through the router.
follow_up: T6 (ics-import-t6): integrated end-to-end user journey + documentation — now the only remaining packet and unblocked (backend T1–T3 and frontend T4–T5 complete).
important_context: T3 implementation already existed in the tree (import_ics handler in backend/src/http.rs, route mounted in build_application_router, Standard-tier classifier in backend/src/rate_limiter.rs); the only acceptance gap was the HTTP-level calendar_import_limit_exceeded code, closed by the new additive test ics_import_http_exposes_stable_limit_code.

The new test sends a 1001-event ICS body (~88 KB, under the 1 MiB body limit) and asserts 400 with error.code == calendar_import_limit_exceeded, proving the limit failure end-to-end through the router.
Handler logs are content-free: only actor_user_id, calendar_id, error_code, byte_count, latency_ms, imported_events, imported_exceptions.

Verification: cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --locked ics_import → 10 integration tests pass (including the new one) plus rate_limiter::tests::test_write_endpoint_tier_standard_ics_import; full backend suite 719 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
Uncommitted worktree changes preserved and untouched: backend/src/event.rs (T1/T2 caldav change recording), .agent/tasks/*.json, mcp-server/* files, untracked .agent/runs/ artifacts. No commits made.

Frontend already consumes the endpoint contract (T4/T5 complete): route /api/v1/calendars/:calendar_id/import-ics, content type text/calendar; charset=utf-8, success body {imported_events, imported_exceptions}, error codes invalid_calendar_file / calendar_import_limit_exceeded / not_found.
